description: This is a Swift source file defining the ScreenController class, which manages a WebView UI component in an iOS application. It handles URL navigation, state updates, JavaScript evaluation, and snapshot creation for the web content displayed within the app.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A final class that manages a WebView for displaying web-based UI, supporting URL navigation, debugging, state management, and snapshot functionality within an iOS app.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the WebView to a specified URL string, with optional trust for A2UI actions.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current web content based on the urlString, handling file URLs and remote URLs.

methods.name: showDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Resets the URL to show the default scaffold UI.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status title and subtitle.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status settings to the web view.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the state JSON for the home canvas.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the web view to render the home state.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the A2UI to become ready within a specified timeout.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript in the web view and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Creates a PNG snapshot of the web view content and returns it as a Base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Creates a Base64-encoded snapshot (PNG or JPEG) of the web view content, with optional quality setting.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Attaches a WKWebView instance to the controller and loads content.

methods.name: detachWebView
methods.description: Detaches the current WKWebView instance from the controller.
